sets.notes: The card text is an imperative („Nenne drei …“) and ends with a full stop. Any three of Richard von Weizsäcker (in office at reunification, until 1994), Roman Herzog, Johannes Rau, Horst Köhler and Christian Wulff count; the answer lists all five so any selection can be matched. Siblings use interrogative form.
